final: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS n FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av, SUM(n) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.k AS tradekind, c.n AS trader_count, CAST(c.n AS REAL) / a.tot AS share_of_total, c.n - a.av AS diff_from_avg FROM c, a WHERE a.av IS NOT NULL AND c.n > a.av
